known_before_registration: hybrid-shift-v2-substitution (PR #40): H1, H2, edge, and hapax all pass 20/20 at primary; token-order-share fails 0/20, a wide margin -- reported as INVALID_CONSTRUCTION for a coupling x novelty interaction, not a coupling main effect alone (PR #40's own correction addendum).

PR #44 causally traced the order-share failure to the coupling mechanism's TARGET_INITIALS lookup (target = TARGET_INITIALS[ATOMIC_ALPHABET.index(prev_last) % 4]), which forces a coupled token's first character into 1-of-4 values whenever coupling fires -- a controlled intervention (position0-priority, PR #46) confirmed this causally but did not fix it.

Steering Committee Meeting #6 (2026-09-22) formalized widening this mapping as the concrete next decision, named three options, and deferred choosing. Meeting #9 (2026-09-23) decided: adopt a new, separately-labeled coupling-v2 track alongside the existing frozen coupling rule -- additive, not a replacement.

This design's own reasoning (logs/2026-09-23-claude-coupling-v2-selfreview.md), written before any code was run: coupling-v2 replaces the 4-way TARGET_INITIALS lookup with a full-width identity mapping (target = prev_last, 26 distinct possible targets, zero concentration by construction) -- the maximally decisive single test of PR #44's concentration hypothesis, chosen over an intermediate width (e.g. %8 or %13) specifically to avoid an ambiguous partial result.

Two correctness points checked directly before registration: the baseline (beta=0.0) control is coupling-rule-independent and safe to reuse by reference (coupling never fires when beta=0.0); the edge_only (beta=0.5, nu_shift=0, nu_sub=0) control is NOT coupling-rule-independent and must be recomputed fresh under coupling-v2, not reused from the v1 hybrid's reference.
not_done_before_registration: No coupling-v2 stream generated or scored
No nu_sub pilot run under coupling-v2
No parameter selected from any transformed outcome
No edge_only or baseline value computed under coupling-v2

claim: Replacing hybrid-shift-v2-substitution's coupling target rule with the maximally-wide identity mapping (target = prev_last, in place of the 4-way TARGET_INITIALS lookup), keeping the boundary-shift-v2 component, the substitution top-up, beta, and nu_shift unchanged, passes all six frozen criteria in at least 16 of 20 primary replicates.
honesty_precommitment: This is a targeted test of a specific causal hypothesis (PR #44: concentration into few target values causes the order-share failure), not a guaranteed fix: coupling's target-selection width may not be the only or full explanation (the boundary-shift-v2 and substitution-top-up components' own interaction with coupling, documented in PR #40's correction addendum, could contribute independently of target width). If order-share still fails at maximum width, that will be reported plainly as evidence against the concentration hypothesis being the full explanation, not retuned, reframed, or followed immediately by an intermediate-width retry without a fresh precommitment. If fixing order-share breaks something the v1-coupling hybrid passed (H1, H2, edge, hapax), that will also be reported plainly as a new negative result.
base_mechanism: Naibbe cipher (voynich-units commit 956a7c4fc39981f4d116fa3f4edfccce6d065571) + coupling-v2 boundary-coupling rule (beta=0.50 fixed, unchanged trigger probability; target-selection rule changed per above).

comparability_note: coupling-v2 is an ADDITIVE track. Every existing mechanism result under the original coupling rule (beta=0.5, 4-way TARGET_INITIALS) remains exactly as merged, permanently comparable, and is not reinterpreted or superseded by this design regardless of its outcome. This manifest and its results are labeled coupling-v2 in every filename and report heading to keep the two tracks unambiguous.
